english.note: Use this when the rude behavior is especially rough, blunt, or uncouth rather than merely lacking politeness.
Use this when an action is done rudely or without gentleness rather than merely imprecisely.

examples.english: They rudely yelled at someone so loudly that even the customers at the next table could hear.
